continuous_authority: Copy existing r_net_fraction, preserving numerator/denominator; display Decimal at60-digit precision; independently reconstruct from saved raw debit/credit
cost_handling: Effective costs already applied once; no additional fee subtraction

positive_labels.observed_tail: Mechanically extend integer k11..floor(100*max(r)) when max exceeds10%; descriptive only

negative_labels.observed_tail: Mechanically extend integer k11..floor(-100*min(r)) when min below-10%; descriptive only

exclusive_bucket: k=floor(100*r); [k/100,(k+1)/100), across all integer k from observed floor minimum through observed floor maximum; include empty buckets; unknown has no bucket
quantiles: Descriptive Entry return quantiles only, exact linear interpolation type7 at1/5/10/25/50/75/90/95/99%; never score quantiles
U_unknown_definition: Neither U5 nor U10 may be imputed; retain source flags and R-unknown separately
funded_flow: Unique original V5 chain150 trades, exact debit/credit/shares/holding, plus each saved reset account separately; never aggregate overlapping windows as unique market opportunities
miss_quantity: No counterfactual funded quantity exists for missed entries; report null recovery shares. Reference100-share labels are not recovered portfolio shares
time_bands: Descriptive fixed market-clock hourly intervals anchored00:00; no outcome-driven cut
occupancy: funded_slot is concurrent positions immediately after that BUY; pre-decision occupancy is native slot admission state; stored minute curve occupancy is after the whole batch

scores.direction: Original higher raw score for every R/RN threshold; no score inversion
scores.MOVE_U2_U3_bucket_limitation: No formal training-derived q2/q3 rank bucket in runtime schema; do not invent a test split. Use raw AUROC/conditional score means and inherited native buckets
scores.strata: Original block/session schedule only, no new split
scores.CI: None; reset windows overlap; no independent-sample significance claim

unknown: null; exclude from event and non-event denominators; include counts/masks
design_only: At most one next mechanism hypothesis; no threshold optimization or implementation; no wealth-gain claim
